title: SnapStash – Small
description:
SnapStash – Small
The Small SnapStash is designed around the need for a on the go ground herb storage container. It is fully sealed so your herb stays fresh and no smells escape.
Please Note: Logo no longer is standard on these snap stashes.
Dimensions
Height – 40 mm
Diameter – Approx 21 mm
Included
1 x Small SnapStash
